main_text.head: MEDICARVM LIBER IV. De SIGNIS. CAP. I. Signorum Divisio.
main_text.p: MOrborum natura & sedes innotescunt nobis signorum auxilio; quibus ignoratis, illa pariter ignorari necesse est. Ordinis ergo ratio huc manuducit ut Σημειωτικὴν persequamur, dignissimã medicinæ partem. page.notes: The Greek word Σημειωτικὴν is printed in Greek letters as shown. Marginal notes on the right-hand page are too cropped and faint to read reliably, so they are not transcribed. Catchword "con-" is at the foot of the column but is a line-end hyphenated word and is kept in the text.
